description: This Java class 'ConvertTree' processes the output of the DOS 'tree' command to build a content hierarchy in OFBiz. It creates Content and ContentAssoc entities to represent directory structures and files, enabling a document tree structure within OFBiz.

classes.name: ConvertTree
classes.description: Main class providing methods to convert DOS 'tree' command output into a content hierarchy in OFBiz.

methods.name: convertTree
methods.description: Reads a file containing DOS 'tree' command output and constructs a content hierarchy in OFBiz, creating Content and ContentAssoc entities accordingly.

methods.name: createSubContent
methods.description: Creates sub-content entries under a specified root content based on parsed line data, establishing content relationships.
